title: Regime-Aware Trinomial Option Contract (FRT-1)
description: A Boyle trinomial (up/stay/down) option-pricing record whose MIDDLE branch projects to the regime's stable point. The regime kind is drawn from the memory-mesh process->regime->option crosswalk (memoryless->Black-Scholes; mean_reverting->the OU reversion target mu, with theta/mu/half_life consumed from the memory-mesh OU fit; trending->drift-dominated; chaotic->attractor centroid). Every node's ternary branch probabilities lie in [0,1] and sum to 1. Deterministic, stdlib-only, measurement/simulation/audit only.

regime_priced.description: true iff a mean_reverting/chaotic regime's price DIFFERS from Black-Scholes (the regime was actually consumed). A regime-aware record identical to BS across all regimes is REJECTED.

branch_probabilities.description: Per-node (pu, pm, pd) triples; each in [0,1], each summing to 1.
